records.japanese:

records.english: Admiral Hayreddin took his father-in-law's name. The man was so great, the Ottomans made him Sultan of Algiers!{PAD}
records.source_meaning: Admiral Hayreddin inherited the name of his giri-no-chichi (father-in-law, a non-birth father). That man was so distinguished that the Ottoman Empire invested him as Sultan, meaning king, of Algiers.
records.localization_note: The Japanese explicitly states giri-no-chichi, not biological father. Read it as father-in-law and preserve inheritance of the name and Ottoman appointment of that earlier man, not the present admiral. Sultan is already the established English title; its Japanese parenthetical king need not be repeated. No spouse name or adoption story is invented.
